name: Molly Criscitello
public_footprint:
Potsdam resident; wrote a 2020 letter to the editor in North Country Now thanking Rep. Elise Stefanik for North Country advocacy. Also appears on a Meal Train page as the mother of a baby girl born April 7th (with Nick Waite).
Sources: https://eliseforcongress.com/2020/05/11/letter-to-the-editor/; https://www.mealtrain.com/trains/zz278d
